title: Kaspa network health analytics from our own Rusty-Kaspa full node: block-rate pr
description: Kaspa network health analytics from our own Rusty-Kaspa full node: block-rate progression (blocks/sec, % of 10 bps target), DAA score advancement, tip-parallelism (concurrent chain-tips = DAG structure), mempool utilization, peer-count stability, and sync uptime over configurable window (1-168h). Node-backed (v1.1.0). Informational research data — not investment advice.
